name: Griffith Scott Reid Memorial Scholarship (PNG law students)
summary: $5,000 plus a paid law clerkship for a Papua New Guinean student starting a Bachelor of Laws (Hons) or Juris Doctor at Griffith.
key: The scholarship is valued at $5,000 in total.
who: Citizen of Papua New Guinea or demonstrated affinity with the PNG community
Applied for an eligible Griffith law program
how: Apply for the law program, then submit a scholarship application with academic records and a personal statement; shortlisted applicants are interviewed

source.label: Griffith University: Scott Reid Memorial Scholarship
